plugin.name: Route Toolbar
plugin.summary: Route-aware coastal passage planning and pilotage tools
plugin.author: Ulf Andreasson
plugin.description: Route-aware EBL/VRM, parallel indexing, turn geometry, leg course/distance labels, Route Objects and passage-plan reports. OpenCPN remains the owner of routes and waypoints. Alpha release for testing with OpenCPN 5.14.x.
